text: My day starts at six-thirty. I don’t use an alarm clock anymore; my body just wakes up naturally. First, I drink a large glass of water and stretch for five minutes. Then, I make coffee and review my to-do list for the day. By eight, I am at my desk, starting work. My job as a graphic designer keeps me busy until five, with a short lunch break where I often take a walk. After work, I go to the gym three times a week. On other days, I just do a quick yoga session at home. Evenings are for cooking a simple dinner, reading, or watching a show. I am in bed by ten-thirty. Sticking to this routine has made me feel more energetic and less stressed, and I highly value that consistency.
